item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 07/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate tomorrow. Winds will be relatively weak and the weather will be humid over the region in the following couple of days. Visibility will be rather low in some areas, and it will be rather warm during the day. Meanwhile, showers associated with upper-air disturbances will affect inland Guangdong. A trough of low pressure will form over central China towards the weekend and develop into a cold front. The cold front is expected to move across Guangdong on Saturday. The associated showers and squally thunderstorms will affect the region. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, showers will ease off over Guangdong early next week. The weather will improve and temperatures will fall slightly.
